description: The bundled main window ships the internal-alpha product surface: transcript-alpha capture commands, retained-meeting Library with its standing retention overview, exact transcript/title search, content-free voice-profile status, the enrolment evidence listing with the guided sitting recorder (start and stop, encoder-admitted builds only), explicit preserve-first legacy-profile migration, separately confirmed profile reset, the reviewed one-meeting audio-deletion boundary, and the frozen withheld-turn restoration. It has no profile activation, profile-build mutation, note generation, generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, or remote-origin permission.
